## Context

This report covers department `{python} dept` for year `{python} year`.

```{python}
#| label: load-data

import polars as pl

storage_options = {
    "aws_endpoint": f"https://{os.environ['AWS_S3_ENDPOINT']}",
}

```

## Key figure

